title: Train with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="78" r="10" fill="#4A90D9"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="78" r="5" fill="#7EC8F0"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="10" fill="#4A90D9"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="5" fill="#7EC8F0"/>
  
  <!-- Train body -->
  <rect x="10" y="40" width="72" height="34" rx="5" fill="#E8453C"/>
  <rect x="10" y="40" width="72" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FF6B5E"/>
  
  <!-- Cab/top section -->
  <rect x="55" y="22" width="30" height="22" rx="4" fill="#E8453C"/>
  <rect x="55" y="22" width="30" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FF6B5E"/>
  
  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x="60" y="30" width="18" height="12" rx="2" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <rect x="60" y="30" width="18" height="4" rx="2" fill="#D4F5FF"/>
  
  <!-- Smokestack -->
  <rect x="20" y="28" width="10" height="14" rx="2" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <rect x="17" y="26" width="16" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFC84D"/>
  
  <!-- Smile face on front of train -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="52" r="4" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="52" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="4" fill="#A8E6FF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="52" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 24 60 Q 36 72 48 60" stroke="#A8E6FF" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Coupler at back -->
  <rect x="80" y="62" width="8" height="6" rx="1" fill="#F5A623"/>
  
  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x="6" y="62" width="6" height="10" rx="2" fill="#F5A623"/>
  
  <!-- Light beam glow from front -->
  <rect x="2" y="54" width="6" height="6" rx="2" fill="#FFE94D"/>
</svg>
